basic_details.scholarship_name: Asian Institute of Technology (AIT) Royal Thai Government (RTG) Fellowships
basic_details.offering_entity: Royal Thai Government (RTG) Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation & Asian Institute of Technology (AIT)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Asian Institute of Technology (Pathum Thani Main Campus, Bangkok Metropolitan Region, Thailand)
basic_details.major_restrictions: School of Engineering and Technology (SET), School of Environment, Resources and Development (SERD), and School of Management (SOM) - priority in Civil Engineering, Water Engineering, AI/IoT, Energy, Environmental Management, and Remote Sensing/GIS.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~120 to 180 RTG fellowships awarded annually across Master's and Doctoral programs
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to Asian developing countries; typically 15 to 25 Pakistani engineering and environmental science scholars selected annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 22-24 months for Master's; up to 36-42 months for PhD
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: His Majesty the King's / Her Majesty the Queen's Fellowships cover 100% full tuition and registration fees (THB 840,000 to 1,260,000 value) plus monthly accommodation and living allowance of THB 11,500 to 15,000 / month (~PKR 86,250 to 112,500 / month)

nationality_requirements: Citizens of Thailand and Asian countries (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No statutory maximum age limit, though priority is given to early-career engineers and researchers.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree with minimum CGPA 3.50/4.00 (for King's/Queen's Full Fellowship) or CGPA 3.00/4.00 (for Loom Nam Khong / RTG Fellowship) from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00 for full coverage King's/Queen's awards; CGPA 3.00 / 4.00 for standard RTG fellowship.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Civil engineering, water resources, environmental engineering, structural engineering, computer science, data science, energy technology, or remote sensing and GIS.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year students completing degree requirements before August/January intake.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Work experience in infrastructure development, water governance, or environmental consulting advantageous but not mandatory.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.0 (writing 6.0), TOEFL iBT minimum 80, AIT English Language Test (AIT-EET score 6.0), or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Thai language proficiency is NOT required; all instruction and research at AIT are conducted 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to all qualified applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants apply online for AIT admission and select Royal Thai Government (RTG) Fellowship on the financial support section.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold any concurrent full scholarship or fellowship.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition and registration fee waiver for standard program duration at AIT.

admission_application_fee.details: AIT international online application processing fee of USD 25 (or THB 800) paid during portal submission.

accommodation.details: On-campus international graduate dormitory accommodation in AIT student villages provided or covered via monthly accommodation allowance.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free subsistence allowance: THB 11,500 to 15,000 / month (~PKR 86,250 to 112,500 / month) disbursed directly for meals and living costs.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Thai Non-Immigrant ED Student Visa fee paid directly to the Royal Thai Embassy in Islamabad or Consulate in Karachi.

health_insurance.details: AIT Medical Clinic on-campus healthcare and group health insurance plan covering hospitalization.

food_allowance.details: Affordable dining across Aobayana and AIT Cafeteria, including dedicated Muslim Halal dining stalls; meals cost THB 40 to 70.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to AIT Library, geoinformatics labs, regional testing centers, and wind tunnel facilities.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Fieldwork travel and thesis research grant support provided through host academic department and project grants.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Internal campus bicycle network and shared campus transport, plus shuttle vans to Bangkok Red Line commuter rail station (Rangsit).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single international autonomous regional postgraduate institute (Asian Institute of Technology - AIT).
participating_institutions: Asian Institute of Technology (Pathum Thani Campus, Bangkok Metropolitan Area, Thailand)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Internationally chartered postgraduate institute founded by SEATO; globally ranked #1 in Thailand and Top 20 globally for SDG 13 (Climate Action) and SDG 6 (Clean Water).
available_majors: Master's / PhD in Water Engineering and Management
Master's / PhD in Geotechnical and Earth Resources Engineering
Master's / PhD in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
Master's / PhD in Energy, Climate Change and Environment
Master's / PhD in Remote Sensing and Geographic Information Systems (GIS)
Master's / PhD in Environmental Engineering and Management
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree with CGPA >= 3.00/4.00 (3.50+ for King's/Queen's full award), academic transcripts, two recommendation letters, statement of purpose, and English proficiency certificate (IELTS 6.0+ / TOEFL 80+ / MOI).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Water Engineering, Structural Engineering, and AI/Data Science are premier regional hubs; candidates with CGPA >= 3.60 and solid engineering backgrounds stand the highest chance for King's/Queen's Full Scholarships.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus research statements on regional water security, disaster resilience in the Indus basin, or climate adaptation where AIT holds historic leadership and UN agency links.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the AIT admissions portal, complete postgraduate application form, select Royal Thai Government (RTG) Fellowship on the financial section, upload credentials, and pay USD 25 fee.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check eligibility for RTG King's (SET/SOM), Queen's (SERD), or Loom Nam Khong fellowship categories.
Step 2: Register on AIT admissions portal and complete online application form.
Step 3: Upload transcripts, degree certificates, statement of purpose, and English proficiency test or MOI.
Step 4: Register two academic referees who submit evaluation letters online.
Step 5: Pay USD 25 online application processing fee.
Step 6: Academic admissions committee and RTG Fellowship Selection Panel evaluate applications.
Step 7: Shortlisted candidates undergo online interview if required.
Step 8: Official admission offer and RTG Fellowship award issued in May/June (for August intake).
Step 9: Apply for Thai Non-Immigrant ED Visa at Thai Embassy in Islamabad and arrive in Bangkok.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated University Route: Application for admission automatically triggers evaluation for RTG Fellowships based on applicant's CGPA and regional eligibility.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by two academic referees via confidential email links generated by AIT portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose describing academic milestones, research interests, career aspirations, and motivation for pursuing a graduate degree at AIT.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research concept note (2-3 pages) detailing proposed engineering or environmental research topic and regional relevance.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Comprehensive academic CV detailing education, project experience, technical software skills, and honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical interview via Zoom conducted by prospective supervisor and departmental doctoral admission committee.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.0+, TOEFL iBT 80+, AIT-EET 6.0, or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate accepted.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified true copies of transcripts and degree certificates; HEC attestation required for Pakistani credentials upon enrollment.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified official English translation for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via AIT admissions portal.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete Bachelor's / Master's degree certificates and transcripts with CGPA >= 3.00 (>= 3.50 for King's/Queen's).

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Statement of Purpose & Research Concept Note
required_documents_checklist.specification: Statement of purpose and 2-3 page research concept note detailing proposed thesis topic.
Confidential evaluation letters from academic professors submitted electronically.
IELTS Academic 6.0+, TOEFL iBT 80+, AIT-EET 6.0, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate.
Comprehensive academic CV detailing education, projects, software proficiencies, and honors.
Clear color copy of passport bio-data page valid for at least 18 months.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: February 28 (Early Round) / March 31 (Strict RTG deadline for August intake)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake commences in August; application window runs from November to March 31.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Prior CGPA, academic consistency in STEM fields)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Research proposal rigor, engineering problem solving, and development relevance)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 5% (Clarity of vision and commitment to regional development)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 10% (Technical interview performance with prospective supervisor and faculty panel)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: AIT Admissions Committee, School Deans, and Royal Thai Government Scholarship Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-tier review: academic qualification evaluation by specialized faculty followed by RTG scholarship allocation committee vetting.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,500 to 2,000 international applicants across Asian region
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~12.0% to 16.0% for candidates with strong engineering backgrounds and CGPA >= 3.50
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Undergraduate/Master's CGPA >= 3.55 / 4.00, accompanied by strong engineering foundations
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates in civil, environmental, or electrical engineering, water resources, or computer science with clear regional development focus.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from top Pakistani universities (NUST, UET Lahore, NED Karachi, FAST-NUCES, COMSATS, UET Peshawar).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Thailand, Pakistan, Vietnam, Myanmar, Nepal, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Cambodia, Sri Lanka.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official portal ait.ac.th.
AIT does not work with third-party agents charging fees for scholarships; RTG awards are managed directly by AIT.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of USD 25 is paid directly through the secure AIT online portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agent proposals are flagged and rejected; applicants must write their own statements and concept notes.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Thai Student Visa fee in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000.
HEC document attestation in Pakistan: ~PKR 10,000 to 15,000.
Initial pocket money before first stipend cycle: ~THB 10,000 (~PKR 75,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Thai language is required. Reality: AIT is an international institute; 100% of instruction and research is in English.
Myth: Flight ticket included. Reality: Flights to Bangkok are self-funded by the student.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sites claim RTG only covers tuition; King's and Queen's awards cover both 100% tuition and monthly living/accommodation stipends.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain minimum semester GPA of 3.00 out of 4.00 to retain the fellowship each semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research presence at AIT Pathum Thani campus; participation in research seminars and departmental duties.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual progress report evaluated by academic advisor and presented to Dean's office.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may not engage in outside employment; limited on-campus student assistantships permitted.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars are free to seek international careers, postdoc opportunities, or industrial employment globally upon graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Termination of fellowship if GPA falls below 3.00 across consecutive terms or for disciplinary dismissal.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Field of research cannot be changed without written permission from faculty dean and RTG committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions beyond standard 22 months (Master's) or 36 months (PhD) are generally not funded by RTG.
